senses.gloss: ch. m. (cmp. בֶּלַע) the thing swallowed, choking fit.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:4">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ</cite> <he>אהן בלעה שרי</he> in a choking attack it is allowed (to apply remedies on the Sabbath) <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:4">Ib.</cite> <he>הוה ליה בלע</he> had a choking fit; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:5:1">Koh. R. to X, 5</cite> <he>הוה ליה חד בלעא</he>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:5:1">Ib.</cite> <he>לאפקא בִלְעֵיה</he> to get out what he had swallowed.
